title: 環境・エネルギー機械
subtitle: Energy and Advanced Fluid Mechanics
keywords: Energy 2.Fluid machinery 3.Pump, Water or Wind Turbine 4.CFD 5.GX, Contribution to local community
educationalGoal: This course deals with energy related to mechanical engineering from various angles. First, students will learn about the environment and energy issues that are becoming widespread problems in modern society. Among the various energy machines in the mechanical field, especially in the fluid-related field, students will learn the basics of the mechanism, performance, and design of fluid machines such as pumps and turbines. In addition, students will learn how to examine environmental issues from the viewpoint of fluid dynamics and/or GX using CFD.
advice: 1. Use of energy resources 1.1 Energy in nature 1.2 Energy conversion technology 1.3 Energy saving technology 2. Energy conversion technology 2.1 Principle and performance calculations for wind turbines 2.2 Problems in pipeline systems including pumps and water turbines 3. Fundamentals of hydraulic machinery 3.1 Design and performance calculation of pumps 3.2 Design and performance calculation of hydraulic turbines 4.CFD Analysis 4.1 Basic equation of flow 4.2 CFD exercise 5. Comprehensive exercises assignment and presentation
books: 図解 エネルギー工学[森北出版](in Japanese) 流れ学[朝倉書店](in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: Fundamentals of energy machinery are thermodynamics and fluid dynamics, and it is desirable to take these courses first.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain energy problems in Japan.
Be able to explain energy conversion using turbomachinery.
Be able to understand the principles of pumps, wind turbines and turbines and perform performance calculations.
Be able to use CFD for basic flow condition
Be able to actively discuss issues and outcomes about issues in the local community.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) To be able to explain recent and expected energy problems and directions for solving them. (2) To be able to explain the energy conversion using turbomachinery in detail with specific examples. (3) Understand the principles of pumps, wind turbines, and turbines, and be able to calculate their performance. (4) To be able to carry out flow analysis using CFD and discuss the results. (5) To be able to examine various environmental problems from the viewpoint of fluid mechanics, and to be able to present and discuss the contents effectively.
achievementLevels.standard: (1)To be able to explain the expected energy problems. (2) Explain energy conversion using turbomachinery. (3) To be able to explain the principles of pumps, wind turbines and turbines. (4) To be able to perform simple flow analysis using CFD (5) To be able to examine various environmental problems and present the results

lessons.content: Review the course policy, purpose, and outline, and understand the educational goal and achievement level of this subject. Detailed schedule will be explained in the first lecture. Learn about basic flow equations.
lessons.assignments: Review of the lecture on energy states

lessons.content: Learn about the basics of CFD
lessons.assignments: Review of class content Preparation of CFD software

lessons.content: CFD Exercise (Calculation of flow in a pipe)
CFD Exercise (Calculation of flow around an object)
CFD Exercise (Calculation of unsteady flow around an object)

Learn about natural energy, renewable energy, and how to use them to generate electricity. Learn about natural energy, renewable energy, and how to generate electricity using them. Learn about technologies for effective use of energy and cogeneration.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Search for the latest environmental white papers and other related reports to understand the current situation. Review of the lecture on renewable energy.

lessons.content: Learn about energy conversion technology and the basics and theory of wind turbines.
lessons.assignments: Examine the types of windmills and their characteristics. Review of lecture contents Review the theory of wind turbines and their maximum efficiency_

lessons.content: Learn the basics of turbomachinery and pipeline problems including pumps and water turbines.
lessons.assignments: Review the Bernoulli's equation and other relevant parts learned in Fluid Dynamics. Review of pipe system problems considering losses. Review of Exercises

lessons.content: Learn the basics of pumps and fans and their performance calculation.
lessons.assignments: Review Chapter 5 of the Fluid mechanics I textbook and read carefully about the law of angular momentum in Section 5.3. Review the problem of a conduit system with a pump.

lessons.content: Learn about the basics of water turbine.
lessons.assignments: Review of exercises Review of class content on principles, performance and selection methods of water turbines

lessons.content: CFD exercise, report writing and presentation

Students are required to conduct a CFD study on the important topics of this course (especially issues including contributions to the local community) and submit a report. Students will make presentations on the contents of the reports using PowerPoint and posters, and discuss them. Self-assessment of learning throughout the class: Students will check their own level of achievement in the learning and education objectives.
